reason: This function matches discounts to dispatch line items by comparing dispatch.lineItems[].id (which for return trips includes a '#return' suffix from getDispatchLineItemKey) against discount.lineItemId (which is the raw lineItem.id without suffix). The mismatch causes promo discounts to never be found for return-trip dispatches, so the discount amount is never written into dispatch.report.price.discount — the root cause of the promo amount not appearing for return trips.
